description.zh:
用户的状态。取值：

- Enabled：启用。
- Disabled：禁用。
description.en:
The new status of the user. Valid values:

- Enabled: The logon of the user is enabled.

- Disabled: The logon of the user is disabled.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，将ID为`u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk****`的用户状态修改为禁用（Disabled）。处于禁用状态的用户，将不能正常登录云SSO用户门户。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to change the status of the user whose ID is `u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk****` to Disabled. Users in the Disabled state cannot log on to the CloudSSO user portal.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso update-user-status --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --user-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --new-status Disabled --region cn-hangzhou
